description: If Citizenship is 054 (Egypt), then National ID is required
If Citizenship is not 054 (Egypt), then Identification Code 1 is required
condition: Citizenship is not None and Citizenship != '054'

description: If Language ID is 001 (English) or 003 (Both), then Subject First Name English is required
If Language ID is 001 (English) or 003 (Both), then Subject Middle Name English is required
If Language ID is 001 (English) or 003 (Both), then Subject Last Name English is required
If Language ID is 002 (Arabic) or 003 (Both), then Subject First Name Arabic is required
If Language ID is 002 (Arabic) or 003 (Both), then Subject Middle Name Arabic is required
If Language ID is 002 (Arabic) or 003 (Both), then Subject Last Name Arabic is required
If Language ID is 001 (English) or 003 (Both), then Address 1 Line 1 English is required
If Language ID is 002 (Arabic) or 003 (Both), then Address 1 Line 1 Arabic is required
Date of Birth must match the birth date encoded in the first 7 digits of Egyptian National ID (CYYMMDD -> MMDDYYYY)
condition: National_ID is not None and len(str(National_ID)) == 14 and str(National_ID)[0] in ['2', '3'] and Date_of_Birth is not None
assertion: str(Date_of_Birth) == (National_ID[3:5] + National_ID[5:7] + ('19' if National_ID[0] == '2' else '20') + National_ID[1:3])

description: Gender must match the 13th digit of Egyptian National ID (even = Female '002', odd = Male '001')
